free_text: A repeat biopsy is indicated due to the presence of a PI-RADS 5 lesion, which is the decisive factor triggering the cohort criterion. This decision is strongly supported by the alignment between the clinical findings and the panel protocol, which was confirmed by the retrieved data showing the PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right mid-peripheral zone. The evidence converged clearly on proceeding with a biopsy to further characterize this high-risk finding.
